question: Should Discord role mentions become explicit wake triggers, and should the contract be an explicit configured role-ID list rather than all bot-held roles or the broader Discord access-list redesign?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a shipped Discord config surface and decides role-addressed fan-out behavior for multi-agent guilds.

options.title: Add explicit trigger roles
options.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into a wake mention while keeping sender roles as access control.

options.title: Fold into access redesign
options.body: Keep this blocked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 defines the broader Discord bypass/mention/deny role semantics.

options.title: Decline role wake triggers
options.body: Keep direct user mentions and @everyone/@here only, and document role mentions as non-wake metadata.

recommendation.title: Add explicit trigger roles
recommendation.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into a wake mention while keeping sender roles as access control.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current routing evidence across the Discord preflight, mention policy, config schema, and prior review context for this surface.
